observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: stage performance inside a minimalist wire-frame cube structure under theatrical lighting against a black background
observation.dancers: four dancers, mixed group of men and women
observation.formation_and_space: group alternates between clustered together, standing in a line, forming a circle holding hands inside the cube, and dancing individually or in pairs
observation.posture: upright posture with flexible torso, frequently bending forward, deep knee bends, and wide stances with weight shifting between feet
observation.footwork: dynamic steps including wide side lunges, quick weight changes, pivots, turns, and floor transitions on the beat
observation.arms_and_hands: arms extend outward, curve overhead, cross over chests, or link hands in a circle formation; hands open with expressive fingers
observation.hips_and_torso: fluid upper body undulations, contractions, sharp torso twists, and rhythmic hip movements integrated into bends
observation.partnering: brief physical contact including linked hand circles, interlocking arms, and synchronized partnering movements
observation.levels_jumps_turns: frequent level changes transitioning from standing extensions down to deep floor crouches, kneeling, floor sweeps, and turns
observation.costume_and_props: dancers wear casual rehearsal-style attire: tank tops and loose-fitting trousers in varying colors (red, pink, grey, orange, green, light blue), bare feet
observation.cannot_infer: exact percussion instrument models and fine footwork detail due to stage lighting and dark background

signature_moments.what: four dancers form a circle holding hands inside the cube while dipping into low squats and rotating together
solo dancer executes a wide leg sweep and deep lunge transition into an upright turn with extended arms
two dancers facing each other mirror sharp arm gestures and coordinated torso contractions
